title: drupilot port manifest (port-manifest.json)
description: The record of what a port or refactor did, in the subject's hidden state dir (<state_dir>/port-manifest.json, project_state_dir, under drupilot's data dir; never in the project tree). The model writes it with the Write tool at the end of a port (commands/drupilot-port.md, skills/minimal-port/SKILL.md section 8) and rewrites it after a refactor (commands/drupilot-refactor.md, skills/full-refactor/SKILL.md), pasting the --json output of several scripts into it; scripts/tests/negative-control.sh --manifest FILE is the only script that writes into it (verification.negative_controls). It is read by scripts/analysis/port-report.sh (every field optional, rendered n/a when absent), common.sh port_record_json / state_snapshot_json / port_manifest_stage, port-summary.sh and layer-report.sh. Only phase is required: it is the one field every instruction names (readers still default it to port). Model-written values are described leniently: list items may be strings or objects, and the embedded script outputs are typed as their scripts print them, with no required keys (the model may paste them in part).

phase.description: "port" (Phase 1) or "refactor" (Phase 2) as instructed; readers also accept ported / refactored in any case.

generated_at.description: When the manifest was written (state_snapshot_json reads it, else recorded_at).

core_strategy.description: The core target strategy used, possibly with a note on how it was resolved.

core_version_requirement.description: The info.yml core_version_requirement after the port.

version_bump.description: The SemVer bump the core target implies.

d10_support.description: declared-not-verified, verified-static, verified-static-above-floor, failed or n/a (from verify-core-matrix.sh when it ran, else core-strategy.sh).

preservation.description: Optional override of the preservation verdict; port-report.sh otherwise reads last-test.json.

rector_official_files.description: Files the official drupal-rector pass changed.

files_changed.description: Files the port changed: a count, or the list of files (port-summary.sh counts it).

deprecations_remaining.description: Hard + unknown deprecations left (soft ones are not counted).

deferred_to_phase2.description: Items left for /drupilot-refactor (strings; port-summary.sh serializes any other item).

patch.description: The local patch path (relative to the subject, or absolute); a non-string is ignored by the readers.

applied.description: The applied rules (a list), or a boolean.

manual_edits.description: The manual changes Rector could not make: a plain string, or {edit, why?, change_record?}.

rector_rules.description: Rector rule hits: run-rector.sh --json .rule_hits ({official: {Rule: n}, digests: {...}}), {Rule: n}, [Rule, ...] or [{rule, hits?, pass?}] (common.sh _rules normalizes them).

rector_reversions.description: Rector changes undone by hand: [{rule, file?, why}] (a plain string is accepted as the rule).

post_port_fixes.description: Fixes made after the validate loop / tests / core matrix found a problem: [{fix, file?, why, detected_by?}] (a plain string is accepted as the fix).

preexisting_bugs.description: Bugs found and NOT fixed by the port: [{issue, file?, note?}].

behavior_changes.description: Changes a reviewer must check in the PR: [{change, why?, review_hint?}].

tooling_deviations.description: Where the flow or a tool's output was not followed: [{what, why}].

validation.description: How the result was validated (strings; port_record_json serializes any other item).

learned_patterns.description: The learned-pattern catalog: the scan run before the port and the ids recorded at its end.

soft_deprecations.description: The JSON of scripts/analysis/classify-deprecations.sh --json (the final run of the phase).

metadata_lint.description: The JSON of scripts/analysis/lint-extension-metadata.sh --json (port-report.sh renders it only when tool is lint-extension-metadata).

origin_hygiene.description: The JSON of scripts/env/origin-hygiene.sh --check --json ({origin, placement, baseline, git, clean, new_untracked, ...}); without it port-report.sh runs the check itself.

verification.description: Evidence beyond the validate loop; each key falls back to the state file its script records.

phpcs_ruleset.description: The .drupilot object of scripts/analysis/run-phpcs.sh --json: which ruleset was used and why.

commit_hooks.description: The JSON of scripts/contrib/git-hooks.sh --run-equivalents when a hook was substituted, else {bypassed: false, note}.

negative_controls.description: Records of scripts/tests/negative-control.sh --json (one per test + type + label; negative-control.sh --manifest writes them here itself).
